accounting.rationale: Informative example of negative integer division; no additional requirement or coverage claim is created.

requirements.title: Integer division yields the integer closest to and between zero and the mathematical quotient
requirements.definition: When one integer operand is divided by another integer operand using /, Table 10.2 makes the expression type integer. The result is the integer closest to the mathematical quotient and between zero and that mathematical quotient, inclusively.
requirements.oracle:
Use nonzero integer divisors and small quotients that cannot overflow. Division by zero or overflow belongs to 10.1.5.2.4 p1, not to this truncation oracle.

S10.1.5.2.2-001 exact integer division runtime fixtures: four complete run/effect/f2023 programs use INTEGER operands and the intrinsic division operator /, then compare the result with independently hand-computed integer literal constants. The cases are 8/3==2, (-8)/3==-2, 8/(-3)==-2 and 8/4==2. Comments in each source show the mathematical quotient and the standard's closest integer between zero and the quotient. The two negative nonexact cases are nonvacuous against flooring division: (-8)/3 would floor to -3 and 8/(-3) would floor to -3, but the standard result is -2. The fixtures use no MOD, MODULO, FLOOR, CEILING, INT, NINT, real or complex oracle, overflow, division by zero, compiler-consensus oracle, or mathematically-equivalent rewrite. Each assertion increments a counter and a final total guard precedes exact completion stdout, empty stderr and exit0. Wrong-oracle mutations cover every guard and completion literal; omissions remove individual observations or the completion line.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
The original source-only catalogue recorded pending plans only and created no Fortran test program, compiler invocation, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim; this generator supplies the selected runtime fixtures and mutation plans without granting those approvals or claims. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal, inquiry, or source-relation oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or any numeric result that 10.1.5.2.4 permits to differ through mathematically equivalent rewriting. Floating-point tolerance is not an escape hatch for a value that is not portably determined.

S10.1.5.2.2-001 exact integer division fixture boundaries: only the four S10.1.5.2.2-001 integer division facets are represented. Positive 8/3 and exact 8/4 are included because they are named catalogue facets, but flooring-vs-truncation sensitivity is carried by the negative dividend and negative divisor cases. The programs do not claim division-by-zero, overflow, real or complex arithmetic, algebraic rewrite permissions, kind-range boundaries, diagnostics, coarrays, multi-image behavior, or universal compiler conformance. Generation grants no review approval, evidence link, baseline update, SourceUse renewal or expected-failure adjudication.

review_rationale: Renewal of the content-bound source review for 10.1.5.2.2 after a fixture packet bound facets into this catalogue. Adding a facet binding changes catalogue content and therefore stales the recorded source review by design; this renewal records that the staleness is attributable solely to the binding. The SOURCE ACCOUNTING IS UNCHANGED by the fixture packets: no base or fine unit was added, removed or redispositioned, no requirement was added or deleted, no requirement identifier was renumbered or reused, and the section's unit hashes against the pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...) are exactly those verified by the original independent source review recorded in the corresponding doc/source_audits receipt. What changed is that facets which were previously pending are now bound to executable fixtures, each of which was independently reviewed as a fixture in its own right, with non-vacuity established by mutation rather than inspection and with the frozen LFortran and the gfortran f2023 qualifying reference both reproduced by the integrator before any adjudication was recorded. This renewal therefore carries forward the original source review's findings unchanged and adds no new source claim. It is not fixture approval, which is recorded separately per case in tests/reviews.json, and it confers no additional execution or coverage credit beyond what those per-case adjudications already state. All facets not bound by a fixture packet remain pending exactly as the original source review left them.
